response.justification: While the candidate has an interesting side project in geospatial data (GISCollective) and some past experience with performance-sensitive distributed systems in DLang, their recent professional trajectory has moved firmly into TypeScript/Node full-stack web development. They lack current, professional-level C++ or Rust experience, have no navigation/routing systems background, and their listed skills do not even include C++ or Rust, making them a weak match for a role centered on modern C++/Rust routing tile pipelines.
strengths: Founder of an open-source geospatial (GIS) platform, showing genuine domain interest and experience with geo-data
Past experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Broad, adaptable technical background across many languages, stacks, and problem domains
concerns: No current or recent professional C++ or Rust experience (last significant C/C++ work was ~2014-2015, brief tenure)
No experience with navigation/routing guidance systems specifically
Recent career trajectory (2018-present) is focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack and product work, diverging from the systems-level C++/Linux focus required

key_factors.factor: Geospatial side project and prior distributed/low-latency systems work
